evidence.claim: West of Brattleboro, the road climbs through hills and forest to Hogback Mountain’s overlook, known as the “100-mile view,” spanning Vermont, New Hampshire and Massachusetts.

evidence.claim: The route’s name honors Molly Stark and commemorates General John Stark’s journey home after the Battle of Bennington.
evidence.quote: Also named for her is the Molly Stark Trail, otherwise known as Route 9, which crosses southern Vermont and commemorates the route used by General Stark on his victory march home from the Battle of Bennington.
